The City report dated 2026-08-19 says the completed plan was to be considered by the Section 79 Committee before submission to Council; the latest Council adoption status has not been verified in this inventory.

minimum_ingestion_contract.privacy_default: No individual survey coordinates, household addresses or person-level mobility traces in the public benchmark
minimum_ingestion_contract.absence_semantics: An unrecorded facility, material flow or informal recovery channel is Unknown unless the source's coverage and observation process establish that absence. Missing records must never be interpreted as zero stock or zero recovery.
weather_profile_requirement: weather_class must be one of observed_station, observed_reanalysis, typical_meteorological_year, design_extreme, observed_event, future_projection, synthetic_fixture
TMY cannot be relabelled heatwave, observed event, forecast or future projection
exact station/grid, period, variables, units, timezone, quality and spatial representativeness must be recorded
minimum_ingestion_contract.spatial_claim_policy: No join may increase native spatial precision or turn ward/sample context into building/household attributes.
minimum_ingestion_contract.thermal_claim_policy: Modelled, calibrated-modelled, measured and independently accepted remain distinct; require owner-native model/sensor receipts.
minimum_ingestion_contract.metroview_policy: MetroView is a public web application with a description of ward-level current/2050 risk. Until underlying layers, methods, endpoints, rights and uncertainties are verified, consume only as attributed ward-level context; do not repackage or upscale.
minimum_ingestion_contract.municipal_gis_policy: CoJ Online Maps viewer access and layer-specific data extraction do not imply layer redistribution rights. Use the 2024 Spatial Data Inventory and custodian contacts to verify per-layer use restrictions.
